title: Gemini 3.1 Pro daily blog engine, distinct trivia quizzes, and language routing
body:
GEMINI 3.1 PRO DAILY BLOG & TRIVIA ENGINE
- Upgraded daily blog generation to flagship Gemini 3.1 Pro (with Gemini 3.8 Flash fallback) using rich multi-fragment Wikipedia context for engaging, grammatically complete fun facts.
- Created an interactive trivia quiz generator producing distinct knowledge-check questions and plausible distractors that do not repeat the fun facts above.
- Hardened blog trivia with dynamic geographic distractors and randomized option positioning across all devices.

LANGUAGE ROUTING & QUERY OPTIMIZATION
- Routed questions asking whether a country has its own national/native language (e.g., 'czy to państwo ma własny język?') to general-knowledge fallback with linguistic identity analysis instead of literal matching.
- Streamlined target country database queries and simplified unresolved question handling.
